info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Pharmacy Prescriptions Fill-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Fill API enables healthcare providers and pharmacies to efficiently manage the process of filling medication prescriptions. This endpoint allows users to submit prescription details for processing, ensuring accuracy and compliance with pharmacy regulations. Typical consumers include pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, and healthcare applications that integrate prescription filling capabilities. It streamlines patient medication management, enhancing service delivery and improving patient outcomes.

post.summary: Fill a prescription for a patient
post.description: This endpoint allows authorized users to manage the prescription fulfillment process by submitting a request to fill an existing prescription for a patient. Ensure that the provided prescription details are complete and valid to successfully process the request.

requestBody.description: Request body for filling a prescription. This should contain all necessary prescription details including medication information, patient ID, and any specific instructions required for processing the fill request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, prescription has been filled.
